team_ledger.entity: team: key on ESPN team id plus a merge table (renames, re-ingests); a team's league is a property of the season (promotion and relegation)
team_ledger.row: one row per team per league match, in date order: date, season (assigned by match date, July to June), competition, team game number in season (tgn), home/away, opponent, GF, GA, result (W/D/L from the final score; AET counts as played, no penalties in league), points (3/1/0)

derived_team_season.P: league matches played (STATUS_FULL_TIME, STATUS_FINAL_AET, STATUS_FINAL_ABANDONED; drop postponed ghost rows and relegation playoffs)
derived_team_season.GF: sum goals for, from the final score (own goals count for the beneficiary)
derived_team_season.points_table: points_on_pitch minus deductions from data/corrections (e.g. Portsmouth 2009-10 -9; Everton 2023-24 -8, later reduced on appeal; Nottingham Forest 2023-24 -4). Pin which one each publisher uses
derived_team_season.position: rank by points_table, then GD, then GF (PL rule); later head-to-head never needed in the gated seasons, assert if it is
derived_team_season.games_left_at_clinch: the team's own remaining league fixtures at the moment a title or relegation became mathematically certain. The moment can be another team's match (Leicester 2016, Liverpool 2020). Clinched relegation: at least (teams - relegation slots) other teams have current points > this team's maximum possible points. Ignore GD unless the publisher counts it (they don't for these gates). Clinched title: no other team's maximum reaches this team's points
derived_team_season.first_n: sum over the team's first N league matches of the season (tgn <= N)

runs.definition: a streak over the team's league matches in this competition in date order, ignoring season boundaries and skipping seasons spent outside the league (Sunderland 2003-05). A run open at the team's last match is 'ongoing' (Derby)
runs.field_floor: a run is visible only if its first match is on or after the ledger floor (eng.1 2002-03); a run already in progress at the floor is truncated and flagged

team_ledger.era_wall: PL era is 1992-93 onward; ledger starts 2002-03, so ten PL seasons (1992-2002, three of them 42-game) are invisible. 'English top flight' (1888-) is a different record book and is never visible
